story: Directory Source Selection for Session Creation
story_description: Users need to specify a working directory when creating a new session. The directory can come from three sources: browsing an existing local folder, cloning a remote Git repository, or creating a new empty project folder. This story enables all three workflows with a unified segmented picker UI.
task_description: Create the DirectorySourcePicker segmented control and its three conditional child views (BrowseDirectoryView, CloneRepositoryView, CreateProjectView) that allow users to specify the working directory for a new session.
atom: Directory Source Segmented Picker and Conditional Views
atom_description: Implement a segmented control with Browse, Clone, and Create segments. Each segment displays a distinct view: Browse shows a path display with NSOpenPanel trigger, Clone shows repository URL and destination inputs with progress indicator, Create shows project name input with parent folder selection and git init toggle. State persists across segment switches.
problem_statement: The current New Session modal only supports browsing for an existing directory. Users who want to clone a repository or create a new project folder must do so outside the app, then browse to that location. This friction discourages starting new projects directly from Blaze and creates extra steps in the workflow.
scope_in: Implement DirectorySourcePicker as a SwiftUI Picker with segmented style containing three cases: browse, clone, create
Implement BrowseDirectoryView with path display TextField (read-only) and Browse button that opens NSOpenPanel for directory selection
Implement CloneRepositoryView with TextField for repository URL, TextField for destination folder path, Toggle for shallow clone option, and ProgressView that appears during clone operations
Implement CreateProjectView with TextField for project name, read-only path display showing computed full path, Change button to select parent folder via NSOpenPanel, and Toggle for git init option
Define DirectorySource enum with associated values: browse(URL), clone(repositoryURL: String, destination: URL, shallow: Bool), create(name: String, parent: URL, initGit: Bool)
Preserve user input state when switching between segments so no data is lost
Validate Clone URL format using regex pattern for common Git URL formats (https, ssh, git protocol)
Show inline validation indicator (checkmark or X icon) next to Clone URL field based on format validity
scope_out: Template selection dropdown for Create mode (future enhancement)
Organization or team directory presets (future enhancement)
Actual git clone execution (handled by separate atom)
Actual directory creation execution (handled by separate atom)
SSH key management for clone authentication
assumptions: SwiftUI Picker with segmented style is available and renders correctly on target macOS versions
NSOpenPanel can be presented from within the modal sheet context without issues
The NewSessionModal.swift file exists and has a location where DirectorySourcePicker can be inserted
Parent view manages the DirectorySource binding and passes it down to DirectorySourcePicker
constraints: Must use SwiftUI only, no AppKit views except NSOpenPanel which requires AppKit interop
Segmented picker must fit within 400pt modal width without truncation
All text fields must support keyboard navigation and accessibility
Clone URL validation must be synchronous and not make network requests
State preservation across segment switches must be immediate with no visible lag

implementation_steps: Step 1: Define DirectorySource enum in Blaze/Sources/Models/DirectorySource.swift with cases browse, clone, create and associated values
Step 2: Create DirectorySourcePicker.swift view with Picker using segmented style and DirectorySource binding
Step 3: Add @State properties in DirectorySourcePicker for each segment independent state: browsePath, cloneURL, cloneDestination, cloneShallow, createName, createParent, createInitGit
Step 4: Implement switch statement in DirectorySourcePicker body that renders BrowseDirectoryView, CloneRepositoryView, or CreateProjectView based on selected segment
Step 5: Create BrowseDirectoryView.swift with HStack containing path Text and Browse Button
Step 6: Implement openDirectoryPanel() function using NSOpenPanel with canChooseDirectories=true, canChooseFiles=false, allowsMultipleSelection=false
Step 7: Create CloneRepositoryView.swift with VStack containing URL TextField, destination TextField, shallow Toggle, and conditional ProgressView
Step 8: Implement validateGitURL(_ url: String) -> Bool function with regex for https://, git@, and git:// patterns
Step 9: Add inline validation indicator Image(systemName:) that changes based on validation result
Step 10: Create CreateProjectView.swift with VStack containing name TextField, computed path Text, Change Button, and git init Toggle
Step 11: Implement sanitizeProjectName(_ name: String) -> String to remove invalid filesystem characters
Step 12: Compute destination path by joining createParent with sanitized createName
Step 13: Set default createParent to FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first
Step 14: Wire all views into DirectorySourcePicker with appropriate Bindings
Step 15: Add DirectorySourcePicker to NewSessionModal.swift in the directory selection section
Step 16: Ensure selectedSource binding in NewSessionModal updates when user completes input in any mode
data_model_changes: Add DirectorySource enum with three cases: browse(selectedPath: URL?), clone(repositoryURL: String, destination: URL?, shallow: Bool), create(name: String, parent: URL, initGit: Bool)
DirectorySource conforms to Equatable and Hashable for state comparison
DirectorySource provides computed property isComplete: Bool indicating whether required fields are filled

CreateProjectView.init(name: Binding<String>, parent: Binding<URL>, initGit: Binding<Bool>) - create mode view
validateGitURL(_ url: String) -> Bool - URL format validation function

ui_states: Initial state: Browse segment selected, no path selected, placeholder text shown
Browse selected with path: Shows full path in text field, Browse button enabled
Browse NSOpenPanel open: Modal sheet showing directory picker
Clone selected empty: URL field empty, destination empty, shallow off, no validation indicator
Clone selected with valid URL: Green checkmark visible, auto-computed destination path shown
Clone selected with invalid URL: Red X visible, destination may be empty
Clone in progress: ProgressView spinning, fields disabled (handled by parent)
Create selected empty: Name field empty, default parent shown, computed path shows parent only, git init on
Create selected with name: Computed full path updates in real-time as user types
Create parent selection open: NSOpenPanel showing directory picker for parent folder
ui_interactions: Tap Browse segment -> BrowseDirectoryView appears with current browsePath state
Tap Clone segment -> CloneRepositoryView appears with current clone field states
Tap Create segment -> CreateProjectView appears with current create field states
Click Browse button in BrowseDirectoryView -> NSOpenPanel opens, selection updates browsePath
Type in Clone URL field -> Each keystroke triggers validation, indicator updates
Type in Clone destination field -> Manual override of auto-computed destination
Toggle Shallow clone -> Updates cloneShallow state
Type in Create name field -> Computed path updates immediately with sanitized name
Click Change button in CreateProjectView -> NSOpenPanel opens for parent folder selection
Toggle Git init -> Updates createInitGit state
Press Tab key -> Focus moves to next interactive element in logical order
Press Escape -> Closes any open NSOpenPanel without selection
ui_copy: Clone destination placeholder: Select destination folder
Create git label: Initialize Git repository
Validation success tooltip: Valid Git URL format
Validation failure tooltip: Invalid URL format
edge_cases: User pastes extremely long URL (2000+ chars) into Clone field - validation must not freeze UI
User enters project name with special characters (slashes, colons, null bytes) - must sanitize to valid filename
User selects parent folder that requires admin permissions - must handle gracefully when creation attempted
User rapidly switches segments while typing - state must not be corrupted or lost
User has no Documents folder (edge case on new/restricted accounts) - fallback to home directory
User pastes URL with trailing whitespace - trim before validation
Clone destination folder already exists - show warning indicator (yellow)
Project name results in empty string after sanitization - disable Create Session button
NSOpenPanel cancelled - do not modify current path binding
User selects symlink as browse directory - resolve to actual path
failure_modes: NSOpenPanel fails to open (sandbox restriction) - log error and show alert explaining permission needed
FileManager cannot access Documents directory - fallback to temporary directory with warning
URL validation regex has catastrophic backtracking on malformed input - use timeout/limit on regex
Memory pressure during rapid segment switching - ensure no retain cycles in view bindings
VoiceOver not announcing segment changes - verify accessibility labels are set correctly
rollback_plan: Revert changes to NewSessionModal.swift to remove DirectorySourcePicker integration. Delete the five new files (DirectorySourcePicker.swift, BrowseDirectoryView.swift, CloneRepositoryView.swift, CreateProjectView.swift, DirectorySource.swift). The modal will return to its previous browse-only behavior. Git revert of the commit containing these changes is sufficient.

acceptance_tests: Given the New Session modal is open, when I view the directory section, then I see a segmented picker with Browse, Clone, and Create options
Given Browse is selected, when I click Browse button and select a folder, then the path appears in the text field
Given Clone is selected, when I enter a valid Git URL, then a green checkmark appears next to the field
Given Clone is selected, when I enter an invalid URL, then a red X appears next to the field
Given Create is selected, when I type a project name, then the full path preview updates to show parent/project-name
Given I am in Clone mode with a URL entered, when I switch to Browse and back to Clone, then my URL is still there

notes: This atom focuses purely on UI components and state management. Actual git clone execution and directory creation are handled by separate atoms. The DirectorySource enum serves as the contract between this UI and the execution logic.

na_justifications.dependency_ids: No dependencies on other atoms - this is a foundational UI component that other atoms will depend on

risks: NSOpenPanel may behave differently when app is sandboxed vs development
URL validation regex could miss valid Git URL edge cases
State preservation logic could have subtle race conditions on rapid switching
Parent folder selection could select folders where user lacks write permission
mitigations: Test NSOpenPanel behavior in both sandboxed and non-sandboxed builds during QA
Use well-tested Git URL regex from established libraries or git-url-parse patterns
Use @State property wrappers correctly and avoid async state updates
Check folder write permissions before allowing selection and show warning if read-only
risk_register.blast_radius: Changes are isolated to NewSessionModal and five new files. No impact on existing session functionality or other UI components.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If issues discovered post-merge, revert the PR. The existing browse-only directory selection in NewSessionModal will continue working. Users can manually clone or create projects outside the app.
